metas.description: Hoping to alter the events of the past, a 19th century inventor instead travels 800,000 years into the future, where he finds humankind divided into two warring races.

metas.name: ★ 6.0 · 2023 · Transformers: Rise of the Beasts
metas.description: During the '90s, a new faction of Transformers - the Maximals - join the Autobots as allies in the battle for Earth.

metas.name: ★ 5.2 · 2016 · The 5th Wave
metas.description: Four waves of increasingly deadly alien attacks have left most of Earth in ruin. Cassie is on the run, desperately trying to save her younger brother.

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 2025 · The Running Man
metas.description: A man joins a game show in which contestants, allowed to flee anywhere in the world, are pursued by "hunters" hired to kill them.

metas.name: ★ 6.8 · 1980 · Superman II
metas.description: Superman agrees to sacrifice his powers to start a relationship with Lois Lane, unaware that three Kryptonian criminals he inadvertently released are conquering Earth.

metas.name: ★ 5.9 · 2023 · Blue Beetle
metas.description: An alien scarab chooses Jaime Reyes to be its symbiotic host, bestowing the recent college graduate with a suit of armor that's capable of extraordinary powers, forever changing his destiny as he becomes the superhero known as Blu...

metas.name: ★ 6.3 · 1979 · Moonraker
metas.description: James Bond investigates the mid-air theft of a space shuttle, and discovers a plot to commit global genocide.

metas.name: ★ 5.6 · 2003 · The Core
metas.description: The only way to save Earth from catastrophe is to drill down to the core and set it spinning again.

metas.name: ★ 5.2 · 2022 · Moonfall
metas.description: A mysterious force knocks the moon from its orbit and sends it hurtling on a collision course toward earth.
